intro.title: Free up space in minutes
intro.body: Tazala finds similar shots, duplicates, screenshots, blurry photos and large videos, so you can review your gallery quickly.

privacy.title: Your photos never leave your phone
privacy.body: All analysis happens on this device. Tazala has no servers, no accounts and no tracking, and it never uploads anything.

access.title: Access to your gallery
access.body: Tazala needs access to your photos and videos to analyze them. Nothing is deleted without your confirmation.

permission.deniedBody: Tazala can't see your gallery. Allow access to photos and videos in Settings to start cleaning up.
permission.limitedBody: Tazala only sees the photos you selected, so the results will be incomplete. Select more photos or allow full access.

dashboard.cloudOnly_one: {{count}} photo is stored only in iCloud and wasn't analyzed.
dashboard.cloudOnly_other: {{count}} photos are stored only in iCloud and weren't analyzed.

scan.title: Analyzing your gallery
scan.errorBody: Something went wrong while analyzing the gallery. The results found so far are saved.

similar.title: Similar photos
similar.description: Series of shots taken within a few minutes. The best photo in each group is kept; the rest are selected for removal. Tap a photo to change the selection.
similar.empty: No series of similar photos found.

duplicates.title: Duplicates
duplicates.description: Identical copies of the same photo. One copy is kept in each group.

screenshots.title: Screenshots
screenshots.description: Screenshots, newest first. Select the ones you no longer need.

blurry.title: Blurry
blurry.description: Photos that look out of focus or shaken, the blurriest first.

videos.title: Large videos
videos.description: Videos above the size threshold, largest first. You can change the threshold in Settings.

category.moved_other: {{count}} files moved to the Tazala trash
category.scanningBody: Results will appear here once the analysis finishes.

swipe.title: Swipe review
swipe.randomHint: A random mix from your whole gallery
swipe.emptyBody: Photos will appear here after the gallery is analyzed.
swipe.keepHint: Keeps this photo and shows the next one
swipe.trashHint: Moves this photo to the Tazala trash
swipe.cardHint: Swipe left to remove, right to keep, or use the buttons below

swipe.finishedBody_other: {{count}} photos ({{size}}) are in the Tazala trash. Nothing is deleted until you confirm.

trash.title: Tazala trash
trash.description: Nothing here has been deleted yet. Tap photos to put them back, or delete everything at once.
trash.emptyBody: Photos you select in categories or in swipe mode will appear here.
trash.confirmBodyIos: {{size}} will be moved to Recently Deleted in the Photos app. iOS will ask you to confirm.
trash.confirmBodyAndroid: {{size}} will be deleted from your gallery. Your phone may ask you to confirm.

trash.partial_other: {{count}} files couldn't be deleted and stay in the trash.
trash.failed: Could not delete the files. Please try again.
trash.iosRecentlyDeleted: On iPhone, deleted photos go to “Recently Deleted” in the Photos app. The space is freed after you empty that album or automatically after 30 days.

settings.title: Settings
settings.similarityDescription: How alike photos must be to end up in one group.
settings.similarityHighHint: Finds more, may group different shots
settings.rescanBody: All photos will be analyzed again. This can take a few minutes.
settings.resetSwipesBody: Every month will be available for review again. The trash is not affected.
settings.free: Tazala is free, has no ads and works without internet.

summary.title: In short
summary.body: Tazala doesn't collect, send or sell any data. Your photos and videos are analyzed only on your device and never leave it.

access.title: Access to photos
access.body: Tazala asks for access to your photo library to find similar photos, duplicates, screenshots, blurry photos and large videos. You can limit or revoke access at any time in your phone's settings.

processing.title: How analysis works
processing.body: The app reads small thumbnails of your photos and calculates technical fingerprints (for example, a sharpness score and an image hash). Original files aren't copied or changed.

storage.title: What is stored
storage.body: Analysis results, your choices and the Tazala trash are kept in a local database inside the app. They're removed when you uninstall the app.

network.title: Internet, analytics and ads
network.body: Tazala makes no network requests. There's no analytics, tracking, advertising or crash reporting, and no accounts.

deletion.title: Deleting photos
deletion.body: Photos are deleted only after you confirm in the app and in the system dialog. On iPhone, deleted photos go to “Recently Deleted” for 30 days.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: If you have questions about privacy, contact the developer through the App Store or Google Play page.
